create_LiltConfig: create a LiLT model configuration with default transformer hyperparameters
initialize_LiltConfig_parameters: initialize a LiLT configuration with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and channel_shrink_ratio
access_LiltConfig_model_type: access the LiLT model type string from a LiltConfig instance
configure_LiltConfig_embeddings: configure a LiLT config with custom max_position_embeddings and max_2d_position_embeddings values
configure_LiltConfig_dropout: configure a LiLT config with custom hidden_dropout_prob and attention_probs_dropout_prob values
